flagged.title: The Five Pillars, Ten Obligatory Acts & Shahadah
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents Jihad as one of five 'shared pillars' of Islam alongside five separate Shi'a practices, teaching a wrong list of the Five Pillars of Sunni Islam which would cost students marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: Now they definitely share those core duties like Salah, Sawm, Zakah, Hajj, and Jihad, but they also follow five additional practices.
